provenance: Assistant-authored, manually inspected illustrative text triples. Not real-video transcripts or an independently annotated benchmark.

cases.anchor: Set aside some of every paycheck to cover unexpected expenses without borrowing.
cases.positive: Build an emergency fund by saving part of each salary payment for surprise bills.
cases.negative: Spend your entire wage on luxury purchases and use credit for emergencies.

cases.anchor: Test yourself from memory instead of repeatedly looking over the textbook.
cases.positive: Practice recalling facts without notes rather than rereading chapters.
cases.negative: Record textbook publishing costs and calculate the bookstore profit margin.

cases.anchor: Create a clear cover image that explains the video's promise to potential viewers.
cases.positive: Design the thumbnail so people understand what watching will offer them.
cases.negative: Study how image compression reduces file sizes without changing the picture.

cases.anchor: Find out whether people who watched last month came back for another upload.
cases.positive: Measure how many previous viewers returned to watch new channel content.
cases.negative: Count first-time visitors who have never watched the channel before.

cases.anchor: The speaker recommends avoiding loans to pay for a vacation.
cases.positive: The advice is to save for travel and stay out of debt.
cases.negative: The speaker recommends taking loans to pay for a vacation.

cases.anchor: A comedian jokes with an audience member about their job.
cases.positive: A stand-up performer playfully questions a spectator about their occupation.
cases.negative: An interviewer seriously questions a comedian about their job.

cases.anchor: Check why viewers leave a video before its explanation finishes.
cases.positive: Investigate audience drop-off during the unfinished explanation.
cases.negative: Explain why a video editor leaves a job before a contract finishes.

cases.anchor: A shorter excerpt reuses dialogue from a longer recording of the same performance.
cases.positive: This clip contains material already present in the complete show.
cases.negative: A new performance covers a similar subject using entirely different dialogue.

cases.anchor: The video begins deliberately with the creator's recognizable brand sequence.
cases.positive: A familiar branded opening starts the upload at an intentional slow pace.
cases.negative: A malfunction leaves the beginning of the video blank and silent.

cases.anchor: Compare each video's views during its first seven days after release.
cases.positive: Use the same initial week of exposure for every upload's view count.
cases.negative: Compare older lifetime totals with views on a clip published this morning.
